name: Settle up (many IOUs, fewest payments)
use_when: several people paid for different things on a trip or over weeks and the group wants to square up
'settle up', 'untangle', 'square up the ious', 'who pays who after the trip', 'figure out the venmos for the whole weekend'
two or more payers in the chat: Priya paid the airbnb, Sam paid gas, Leo got groceries
dont_use_when: one person paid one bill and the rest pay them back (use split)
buying tickets for the group (use tickets)
gas or parking for one car (use carpool)
guarantees: all money is integer cents; each IOU splits evenly across who it was for, the first people by id pay the leftover cents, and balances add up to zero
untangle gives the provably fewest payments: people minus the most groups that net to zero
the open payments clear every balance exactly; only the payer or the person paid marks a payment, once
anyone in the chat can add an IOU they paid; a new IOU clears the plan until someone untangles again
someone who leaves comes off the ledger with their IOUs, shares and payments

title.description: What the money was for, e.g. 'Nashville trip'

paidBy.description: Who paid, exactly as in the members list

forWho.description: Who it was for, payer included if they shared it; empty for everyone in the chat

ious.description: IOUs from the chat, up to 20
